description: Big white address-side envelope diagram, 1200x760 at scale 1, #ead9a8 border, ink outline 3 px: blank dashed top-right stamp box (#stamp-box), blank address block of 4 grey rules (#address-block), faint top band (#top-zone). No lettering.
Round ink postal date-stamp impression, 300x300: double ring, blank straight date bar across the middle, blank office arc; ink #2b2622 at 85% opacity. No real office name.
Drawn postal-red (#9e1b1b) pillar letter box, 260x520: rounded cap, dark slot, cream plate (blank), plinth; ink outline 3 px. Stand-in when the photo is missing.
Brown-paper packet (#c9a978 on cream) tied crosswise with sand string, a white blank tag hanging from a loop; 420x320. Parts #packet, #string, #tag.

Two generic labels side by side, no real design, words or emblem: #revenue a grey-green rectangular stamp with wavy frame and blank centre; #charity a round pale-yellow sticker with a heart outline. 360x200.

White card, address side, 560x360: two thick ink vertical bars near the right edge (#bars), blank top band for postmarks (#top-band), blank address block (#address-block), blank permit-number line (#permit-line). No lettering.
White ruled form sheet 300x400: blank surface-coloured header strip, six blank rows, signature line at the bottom; ink outline. Used as invoice, statement of mailing, journal, bill and daily account.
Canvas-sand mail bag with drawstring neck and a postal-red band, envelope corners peeking out of the mouth; 320x380.
Hand-held rubber date stamp: wooden knob, neck, slate base, side view; 200x300.
